name: SideNavigation
description: Vertical sidebar navigation with nested items and active state tracking. Supports hierarchical navigation structures with expandable sub-navigation groups.

notes: Renders as a <nav> element with aria-label for landmark identification.
Active item is marked with aria-current='page'.
Parent items with sub-navigation use aria-expanded to communicate state.
All items are keyboard navigable with visible focus indicators.

items.description: Array of navigation items, each optionally containing nested sub-navigation items.

activeItemId.description: The itemId of the currently active navigation item.

onChange.description: Callback fired when a navigation item is selected.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

do: Use SideNavigation for primary vertical navigation in dashboard or admin layouts.
Provide a meaningful aria-label to distinguish this navigation from others.
Keep nesting to a maximum of two levels for usability.
dont: Do not use SideNavigation for horizontal or mobile bottom navigation.
Do not nest more than two levels of sub-navigation.
Do not use SideNavigation without an onChange handler for interactive items.
